name: Northwind Studio
note: Fictional example brand for documentation. Not a real company; the domain uses the reserved .example TLD.

bg.name: Pine
bg.use: default dark ground for every scene

surface.name: Moss
surface.use: cards, browser and phone frames on the dark ground

ink.name: Sand
ink.use: headlines and body text on dark

accent.name: Ember
accent.use: the one word or number the scene is about; never decoration

muted.name: Lichen
muted.use: eyebrow labels, captions of captions, axis text

gradients.name: ember
gradients.use: logo needle and underline strokes only; never a full-frame background

ground.dark: flat Pine with a soft top light and 3% film grain

logo.clearspace: the height of the needle on every side

outro.layout: logo-on-dark centered at y 760, handle below, site below that, one CTA line at y 1180

cta.en: Save this and send it to your team.

voice.audience: small business owners and marketing leads
voice.goal: informative clips people save and forward
voice.cta: save + send to a colleague; the service is mentioned at most in the last sentence

do: Every statistic on screen has a source listed in script.md.
Use real screenshots of the tool being discussed, inside the browser template.
Spell jargon out the first time it is spoken.
dont: No full-frame gradients, no grid backgrounds, no neon glow.
No presenter footage; the brand speaks through graphics and voice.
No guarantees, ranking promises or invented client results.
Do not place the watermark bottom-right (platform buttons).
